errors.badRequest.comment: Error page title and message for a 400 response.

errors.forbidden.comment: Error page title and message for a 403 response.

errors.generic.comment: Error page title and message for any other error.

errors.notFound.comment: Error page title and message for a 404 response.

cy.value: Heb ddod o hyd i'r dudalen

errors.unauthorised.comment: Error page title and message for a 401 response. English spelling kept as currently shown.

govuk.dateInput.day.comment: Label for the day field of a date input.

govuk.dateInput.month.comment: Label for the month field of a date input.

govuk.dateInput.year.comment: Label for the year field of a date input.

govuk.notificationBanner.success.comment: Title of a success notification banner.

govuk.pagination.landmark.comment: Accessible name of the pagination navigation landmark.

govuk.pagination.next.comment: Pagination link to the next page.

govuk.pagination.page.comment: Accessible name of a numbered pagination link. {{number}} is the page number.

govuk.pagination.previous.comment: Pagination link to the previous page.

govuk.pagination.previousPage.comment: Visually hidden label for the previous page arrow.

govuk.warningText.iconFallback.comment: Visually hidden text read before GOV.UK warning text.

header.language.toEnglish.comment: Language switcher link to English. Always written in English. Shared key with the iOS app.

header.language.toWelsh.comment: Language switcher link to Welsh. Always written in Welsh. Shared key with the iOS app.

layout.footer.accessibility.comment: Footer link to the accessibility statement.

layout.footer.licence.comment: Footer licence statement. {{link}} is a link whose text is layout.footer.licenceLink.
layout.footer.licence.en: All content is available under the {{link}}, except where otherwise stated

cy.value: Mae'r holl gynnwys ar gael o dan y {{link}}, oni nodir yn wahanol

layout.footer.licenceLink.comment: Link text inside the footer licence statement.

layout.footer.privacy.comment: Footer link to the privacy notice page.

layout.footer.supportLinks.comment: Visually hidden heading for the footer links.

layout.language.navLabel.comment: Accessible name of the language switcher navigation landmark.

layout.nav.account.comment: Service navigation link to the account page.

layout.nav.home.comment: Service navigation link to the catch records list.

layout.nav.menu.comment: Button that opens the service navigation on small screens.

layout.nav.signOut.comment: Service navigation button that signs the user out.

layout.phaseBanner.feedbackLink.comment: Link text inside the phase banner sentence.

layout.phaseBanner.tag.comment: Phase banner tag. GOV.UK services keep 'Beta' in Welsh.

layout.phaseBanner.text.comment: Phase banner sentence. {{feedbackLink}} is a link whose text is layout.phaseBanner.feedbackLink.
layout.phaseBanner.text.en: This is a new service – your {{feedbackLink}} will help us to improve it.

cy.value: Mae hwn yn wasanaeth newydd – bydd eich {{feedbackLink}} yn ein helpu i'w wella.

layout.serviceName.comment: Service name in the header and the browser tab title.

layout.skipLink.comment: Skip link, the first focusable element on every page.
